Usage: agentcage cage update [OPTIONS] [NAME]

  Rebuild and restart an existing cage.

  NAME is optional when ``-c`` is given — the cage to update is taken from the
  config's ``name:`` field. Mirrors ``cage create``, which has never required a
  positional NAME for the same reason.

Options:
  -c, --config PATH
  --no-cache         Force a full image rebuild (ignore podman's layer cache).
                     Use after pulling a fresh agentcage release that changed
                     the Containerfile or any of its build context.
  --pull             Force re-pull of the base image from the registry
                     (--pull=always). Combine with --no-cache for a fully clean
                     rebuild.
  --force            Rebuild and restart even when inputs are unchanged.
  --help             Show this message and exit.
